evidence.quote: RVQ-Alpha addresses all three requirements with a residual-quantized tokenizer whose codes are embedded directly into the vocabulary of the LLM as a fixed representation of 10 tokens per cell.
We deploy Nc = 8 codebooks of C = 32 entries each, a configuration that outperforms alternative ( Nc , C ) choices on held-out reconstruction and clustering metrics (§6.1).

This process adds Nc × C = 256 cell-code tokens; furthermore, per-cell and population-level delimiters separate cells and cell groups, yielding a fixed representation of 10 tokens per cell (eight codes plus two per-cell delimiters).
